answer: Standing decays on a timer. That is the precondition. An identity that skips an epoch loses a fixed slice of score, and any attempt to link two identities resets both to zero. Every claim is then re-checked by an agent with nothing to gain from it. A basalt base of six answered epochs is what a payout needs, so a farm must keep every shell warm through the whole run. The nadir is cheap to reach and expensive to leave. A raven watching the ledger sees the reset before the farmer does.
